result.summary: Adds a single new bounded corrective patch file, docs/validation/evidence/buildings-component-validation-2026-09-20/author-owner-repair.patch, to be applied on top of the supplied candidate buildings.gd. The unified diff touches only godot/scripts/core/buildings.gd, in one hunk inside _columns_furniture_refusal. Under ADR 0183 the candidate's inactive-furniture branch returned _columns_furniture_free_refusal unconditionally, so every inactive row terminated there and retired rows with a retained nonnull room parent never reached the present/state gates; the frozen witness retired-furniture-f_origin_tile--1 therefore observed REFUSE_NONE where COLUMN_FURNITURE_STATE is required (recorded as 65 tests / 11511 assertions / 1 failure). The patch keeps the FREE gate first and returns any FREE refusal immediately, so the null-user requirement for every inactive row is unchanged; it then returns success only for a validated never-used row whose parent pair is exactly the GDD null reference, decided through the existing _columns_ref_is_null helper; otherwise it falls through to _columns_furniture_state_refusal, which is what makes a retired nonnull-parent row with origin -1 earn COLUMN_FURNITURE_STATE. _columns_furniture_free_refusal, _columns_furniture_state_refusal, the building and room domains, the flag and shape gates, the borrowed Columns.new(false) path, the frozen source-fact arrays, the section 1 tile-map code and all older gameplay code are preserved byte for byte. No helper domains, test expectations, contracts, documentation or other code are changed, and no execution, testing or application of the patch is claimed.

files.content:
Bounded corrective patch for BUILDINGS-S4-VALIDATE-R01 v1 (ADR 0183).
Applied on top of the supplied candidate buildings.gd. Restores the ordered
inactive-furniture contract: FREE refusals still win, a NULL-parent never-used
row succeeds, and a retired row with a retained nonnull parent falls through to
the present/state gates, so the frozen retired-furniture-f_origin_tile--1
witness earns COLUMN_FURNITURE_STATE instead of REFUSE_NONE.

diff --git a/godot/scripts/core/buildings.gd b/godot/scripts/core/buildings.gd
--- a/godot/scripts/core/buildings.gd
+++ b/godot/scripts/core/buildings.gd
@@ -1489,6 +1489,10 @@ static func _columns_furniture_refusal(image: Columns, row: int) -> StringName:
 	if (not _columns_ref_ok(image.f_room_slot[row], image.f_room_generation[row])
 			or not _columns_ref_ok(image.f_user_slot[row], image.f_user_generation[row])):
 		return REFUSE_COLUMN_FURNITURE_REF
 	if image.f_present[row] == 0:
-		return _columns_furniture_free_refusal(image, row)
+		var free_code: StringName = _columns_furniture_free_refusal(image, row)
+		if free_code != REFUSE_NONE:
+			return free_code
+		if _columns_ref_is_null(image.f_room_slot[row], image.f_room_generation[row]):
+			return REFUSE_NONE
 	return _columns_furniture_state_refusal(image, row)
